description: Depth-2 box CORNER (an L-with-return): a 40x30 base plate + edge flange F1 (leg 25, folded 90deg up off the y=+15 top edge, bend axis +X) + a SECOND flange F2 (leg 15, folded 90deg off F1's x=+20 SIDE edge, bend axis +Z -- PERPENDICULAR to B1). F2 folds off ANOTHER flange (F1), not the base: depth 2 -- the genuinely-2D-and-composed case the shipped depth-1 unfold used to reject. Built via two shipped build_edge_flange folds (tests/_bend_chain_builder.py, kind='perp'); both bends carry real construction-time provenance. Unfolds via the SHIPPED geometry.sheet_metal.unfold_sheet_metal bend-tree path (graduated from the tractability spike, docs/design/sheet-metal.md sec 4.3).
